req.title: Basic-auth accepts correct credentials
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> with HTTP 200 and an authenticated=true JSON body when the supplied Basic credentials match.

doc.reasoning: The requirement covers GET /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> returning HTTP 200 with {authenticated: true, user: <user>} when correct Basic credentials are supplied. I design: (1) a positive EP test with matching credentials, (2) a negative NEG test with wrong password, (3) a negative NEG test with no credentials, (4) a DT test covering wrong username, (5) a BVA test with single-character credentials at the minimal boundary, (6) a DT test verifying the exact JSON body fields and values to catch boolean/string mutations. Each test uses in-process Flask test client, exact-value assertions, and covers both sides of the boolean check in check_basic_auth.

tests.name: test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_returns_200_and_authenticated_true
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/alice/secret with Authorization: Basic base64(alice:secret)
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()
creds = base64.b64encode(b'alice:secret').decode('ascii')
headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}

def test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_returns_200_and_authenticated_true():
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/alice/secret', headers=headers)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data['authenticated'] == True
    assert data['user'] == 'alice'
    assert len(data) == 2

tests.name: test_basic_auth_response_body_exact_fields_and_values
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Correct credentials supplied for user=testuser, passwd=testpass
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/testuser/testpass with correct Basic credentials
Inspect full JSON body for exact keys and values
expected: JSON body contains exactly keys 'authenticated' and 'user'
authenticated is boolean True (not string, not 1)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-018: exact body shape {authenticated: true, user: <user>}; catches boolean->string mutation, user field mutation
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()
creds = base64.b64encode(b'testuser:testpass').decode('ascii')
headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}

def test_basic_auth_response_body_exact_fields_and_values():
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/testuser/testpass', headers=headers)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert set(data.keys()) == {'authenticated', 'user'}
    assert data['authenticated'] is True
    assert data['authenticated'] != False
    assert data['user'] == 'testuser'
    assert data['user'] != 'testpass'
